text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock D at a profit felt rewarding, but future trades should follow my portfolio goals rather than the urge to lock in gains.","I should not let my average cost or the discomfort of admitting a mistake determine whether I hold or sell; focus on each stock’s prospects from today onward.","A handful of random monthly price moves is not a dependable signal, so I should avoid short-term reactions and trade only when my plan or portfolio needs change."]}
